boards.title: Greenhouse boards
boards.description: Board tokens or any Greenhouse board / job URL, one per line. Examples: `figma`, `https://boards.greenhouse.io/figma`, `https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/dropbox/jobs/8159652`, `https://boards.greenhouse.io/embed/job_board?for=figma`. A bad entry is reported in the run SUMMARY and the others still run.

departments.title: Departments
departments.sectionDescription: All filters are optional and combine with AND.
departments.description: Department names to include, one per line (exact name, case-insensitive). A parent department also includes all its child departments, e.g. `Engineering` covers `Backend`. The DEPARTMENTS_OFFICES record of a run lists the names on each board.

offices.title: Offices
offices.description: Office names to include, one per line (exact name, case-insensitive). A parent office includes its child offices, e.g. `North America` covers `USA` and `San Francisco`.

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Case-insensitive match on job title and department names. Words separated by spaces must all match; separate alternatives with commas (`data engineer, analyst`).

location.title: Location
location.description: Case-insensitive substring of the job location or an office name, e.g. `London`. Separate alternatives with commas (`berlin, remote`).

remoteOnly.title: Remote only
remoteOnly.description: Keep only jobs that look remote. Heuristic: the location or an office name contains remote / work from home / WFH / anywhere, the title has a stand-alone `remote`, or a workplace-type custom field says Remote.

updatedSince.title: Updated since
updatedSince.description: Only jobs updated on or after this date. Use a date (`2026-09-01`, UTC if no time is given) or a relative value (`7 days`, `2 weeks`, `12 hours`, `1 month` = 30 days).

updatedSinceField.title: Date used by 'Updated since'
enumTitles: First published (falls back to last update)
updatedSinceField.description: `updatedAt` also matches old postings that were edited recently. Choose first published to see only newly posted jobs.

includeContent.title: Job description
includeContent.description: Format of the `content` field. Descriptions are always downloaded with the job list, so `none` only makes the output smaller.

includePayRanges.title: Pay ranges
includePayRanges.description: Add `payRanges` (min, max, currency, title in currency units). Needs one extra request per delivered job, so large runs take longer. Only boards that publish pay transparency data return ranges.

includeQuestions.title: Application questions
includeQuestions.description: Add the application form: `questions` (the main questions), `locationQuestions` (the location question, hidden coordinate fields left out), `complianceQuestions` (compliance groups such as EEOC) and `demographicQuestions` (the demographic survey). Each question has its label, required flag, field type and options. Needs one extra request per delivered job (shared with pay ranges).

includeCustomFields.title: Custom fields
includeCustomFields.description: Add `customFields`: the board's own metadata fields as {name: value} (employment type, level, workplace type, ...). Fields differ per company.

onlyNewJobs.title: Only new jobs
onlyNewJobs.description: Deliver only jobs not delivered by an earlier run with the same state key, and pay only for those. The first run delivers everything. State lives in the named key-value store `greenhouse-job-feed-state` of your account.

stateKey.title: State key
stateKey.description: Name of the incremental state. Use a different key per schedule or board set so they do not share their history. Runs with the same key must not overlap: a second run started while another one is still using the key stops with an error.

maxItems.title: Max items
maxItems.description: Maximum number of jobs to deliver in total (each one is a billed result). Split evenly across boards; a board with fewer jobs hands its unused share to the others.
